# Fixture Gate Registry (real rows - frozen, do not edit in place)

Verbatim copy of the header, separator and seven real rows of `_shared/gates-registry.md`
(taken 2026-10-20 at the wave 1 commit of spec 017), so the lint is exercised on the real
cell shapes: a `\|` inside notes, an unescaped `|` inside backticks, exemption suffixes,
`none`, `external`. The skill tree next to it (`skills/`) is a copy of the real workflow
files; none of the three exempt rows is wired there, on purpose.

| id | phase | class | cost | owning file | enforcement | notes | applies_to | invoke |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|

| `gate-0.6-schema` | Execute (per wave) | deterministic | cheap | a1-execute | blocking | Schema/DB-checklist check. Cheap, keep as-is. Added 2026-06/07. | | `schema-check run` @ a1-execute,a1-new-feature; unwired_until=2026-11-30; unwired_reason=spec 017 wave 11 |
| `spec-roadmap-status-coherent` | Phase 4.5 / standalone | deterministic | cheap | a1-checklist (check #11, `_shared/lib/spec-coherence.cjs`) | blocking | NEW (2026-09-26, spec 010-vault-cockpit-contract, Wave 7, FR-028/FR-029). Enforced at a1-new-feature Gate 4.5 (`checklist run <slug>/<feature> --only 9,10,11`) + standalone (`checklist run … --only 11`, `a1-tools product validate --spec-status` for every roadmap feature). Compares `SPEC_TO_ROADMAP_STATUS[spec.status]` with the roadmap feature `status:`: a terminal disagreement (at least one side `done`/`cancelled`) exits 1 and names the reconciling command (`product stage --by <id> --set done` or `spec update-status <path> <status>`); a non-terminal disagreement or an out-of-vocabulary spec status is a warning, an unresolvable spec is `unlinked` (info). Motivated by a measured drift: spec 005 `done` while docs/product/ROADMAP.md said `planned` and recommended it as next (spec 010 F-007) — detected by `product validate --spec-status` on a copy of the live roadmap before reconciliation. No catch data in retros yet. Retro attribution: `{id: spec-roadmap-status-coherent, verdict: pass|fail, caught: <true|false>}`. | | `product validate --spec-status` @ a1-pr-review; unwired_until=2026-11-30; unwired_reason=spec 017 wave 10 |
| `test-fidelity` | Execute (per wave) / Fix verify | deterministic | med | a1-execute, a1-new-feature, a1-fix | blocking | NEW (2026-10-14, spec 017-enforced-self-checks). `a1-tools test-fidelity --diff-base <ref>` - exit 0 no findings / 1 findings / 2 usage or git failure; rules `mock-of-subject`, `test-not-in-ci`, `skipped-test`, `early-return-guard`. Catches green tests that mock the changed code, are not run in CI, are skipped or return early. Wired by waves 4, 7 and 11-12 of spec 017; until then the row carries an exemption. Retro attribution: `{id: test-fidelity, verdict: pass, caught: <true\|false>}`. | | `test-fidelity` @ a1-execute,a1-new-feature,a1-fix; unwired_until=2026-11-30; unwired_reason=spec 017 wave 12 |
| `no-imported-expectations` | continuous (CI, project repos) | deterministic | cheap | `scripts/check-no-imported-expectations.mjs` (n3ural-contentbot) | blocking | NEW (2026-09-13, spec 008). `npm run check:no-imported-expectations` — AST check (TypeScript compiler API) over test files: exit 0 clean / 1 finding(s) / 2 usage-or-parse error. Flags an assertion whose EXPECTED value is imported from the same module as the function under test — class 4 of `_shared/agent-lessons.md#theo-mutation-question`, where the expectation moves with its source. **Has catch data:** mutation-verified against the historical `MAX_REASON_LENGTH` case recovered verbatim from git (a5994b4), and reports **11 pre-existing false-greens** in n3ural-contentbot as of 2026-09-13, each confirmed by mutation (e.g. `HEARTBEAT_STATE_SCHEMA_VERSION` 1→999 leaves all 25 tests of its own suite green). Enum-member comparisons (`toBe(STATUS.MERGED)`) were measured NOT to be this class and are excluded rather than reported as 125 false alarms. FR-002 exception list holds exactly one named entry with its reason. Retro attribution: `{id: no-imported-expectations, ...}`. | | external |
